name: agent-workers
description: Run DeepSeek Harness (dsh) or pi headless workers in parallel, with a live dashboard, a cleanup-aware skill, slash commands, and a native pane.

allowed_roots.title: Allowed project roots
allowed_roots.description: Colon- or comma-separated directories workers may use. Empty uses the MCP server's working directory.

backend.title: Worker backend
backend.description: dsh or pi. Empty uses dsh.

dsh_bin.title: dsh binary
dsh_bin.description: Absolute path to the dsh executable. Empty uses dsh from PATH.

pi_bin.title: pi binary
pi_bin.description: Absolute path to the pi executable. Empty uses pi from PATH.

pi_model.title: Default pi model
pi_model.description: Model for the pi default profile, e.g. openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017:low. Empty uses pi's configured model.

pi_thinking.title: Default pi thinking level
pi_thinking.description: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. Empty uses pi's configured level.

pi_agent_dir.title: pi agent directory
pi_agent_dir.description: Optional PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR for worker processes. Empty inherits the user's pi configuration and auth.

pi_profiles_file.title: pi profiles file
pi_profiles_file.description: Optional JSON file with named pi profiles. Empty uses <state_dir>/pi-profiles.json.

pi_allow_write.title: Allow pi workspace writes
pi_allow_write.description: pi has no sandbox. workspace-write is disabled by default; enable it only with worktree isolation.

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Where job records and logs are kept. Empty uses $AGENT_WORKERS_STATE_DIR (legacy $DSH_WORKERS_STATE_DIR accepted), then an existing ~/.local/state/dsh-workers, then $XDG_STATE_HOME/agent-workers or ~/.local/state/agent-workers.

use_dsh_credentials.title: Read credentials from the DSH store
use_dsh_credentials.description: Read DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_CHAT_API_KEY, and OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY from ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml when they are not already in the worker environment.

max_concurrent.title: Maximum concurrent workers
max_concurrent.description: Hard limit on running worker processes (1 to 8).

profile.title: Starting backend profile
profile.description: dsh profile name, pi model pattern, or named pi profile. Empty uses the backend default.

pane_background.title: Pane background
pane_background.description: Hex color (#rrggbb) for the pane background, e.g. your terminal background so the pane matches the chat. Empty keeps Claude Code’s own pane fill.
